attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) Unbound DNS resolver with a DNSBL blocklist policy that returns NXDOMAIN for blocked.example and all of its subdomains (exact match + wildcard entry), while leaving all other resolution untouched. Repointed node2 and node3 (RHEL7) from the platform gateway to node1 as their authoritative DNS server via NetworkManager. Verified normal domains resolve correctly and blocked.example / arbitrary subdomains return NXDOMAIN from both node2 and node3. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identity (FreeBSD kern.boottime on node1, Linux boot_id on node2/node3) and full post-restart recovery of DNS service and blocking behavior.
